福爾摩沙小導遊臺南 Tainan・安平區

安平海山館Anping Haishan Hostel

想像你是一名來自福建的年輕士兵，奉命渡海駐防安平。1683 年，清朝將台灣納入版圖，並在安平設水師駐防。士兵們從福建輪調而來，遠離家人，思鄉情切。他們興建會館，奉祀家鄉的神明、舉行聚會，也在這裡住宿。它既是廟，也是會館，也是宿舍：兩百名士兵在異鄉的家。清兵共建了五座廟館，如今只剩這一座。館名源自原駐地福州海壇島上的一座山「海山」。抬頭看門楣：一尊「伏地挺身」的綠色劍獅。綠色代表綠營軍。院子裡有一口老井。這裡挖得到淡水。沒有水，就沒有城！找找六角窗和八角窗、葫蘆、銜磬獅，還有屋頂上的風獅爺。

Imagine you are a young soldier from Fujian, sent across the sea to defend Anping. In 1683, the Qing empire took Taiwan and stationed a naval garrison at Anping. The soldiers rotated over from Fujian. Far from their families, they were homesick. So they built halls to worship the gods of their hometowns, hold gatherings, and sleep. At once a temple, a clubhouse and a dormitory, it was home away from home for two hundred soldiers. Five temple-hostels were built for the Qing soldiers; only this one remains. The name comes from a mountain called Haishan on Haitan Island, Fuzhou, where the battalion was first stationed. Look up at the gateway: a green sword lion in a push-up position. Green stands for the Green Standard Army. In the courtyard is an old well. You can dig down to fresh water here. No water, no fort! Find the hexagonal and octagonal windows, the gourds, the lion with a stone chime, and the wind lion on the roof.

一分鐘看懂

One-minute intro

為什麼值得來

Why it matters & history

海山館是清代從福建輪調來台駐防的班兵所建的會館，既是廟也是宿舍。清兵在安平共建五座廟館，如今只剩這一座；門楣上的綠色劍獅，代表清代綠營軍。

The Haishan Hostel was built by Qing soldiers sent from Fujian to guard Anping. It was a temple, a meeting hall and a dormitory at once. Of the five such halls they built, this is the only one left.

  1. 1683清朝將台灣納入版圖，在安平設水師駐防。The Qing take Taiwan and station a navy garrison in Anping.
  2. 清代 Qing era福建輪調的班兵興建會館，奉祀家鄉神明並在此住宿。Rotating soldiers from Fujian build the hall to honor home gods and to live in.
  3. 今天 Today五座廟館中唯一留下的一座，保留老井、六角窗與八角窗。The last of the five halls, with its old well and hexagonal and octagonal windows.

認識景點

About the place

會館、宿舍：同鄉的人聚會、住宿的地方。 駐防士兵、班兵：被派去駐守某地的士兵；他們從福建輪調而來。 輪調、輪流：輪流替換：士兵駐防一段時間後回鄉。 綠營：清代由漢人組成的軍隊；所以劍獅是綠色的。

hostel: A place where people from the same hometown meet and sleep. garrison soldier: A soldier sent to guard a place. These soldiers rotated over from Fujian. rotate: To take turns. Soldiers came for a time, then went home. Green Standard Army: The Qing forces made up of Han Chinese soldiers. That's why the lion is green.

刀劍屏、屏風：正殿裡的屏風，用來鎮宅避邪。 馬背山牆：側牆頂端圓弧形，像馬的背。 石磬：獅子咬著石磬；「磬」和「慶」同音。 六角形的：有六個邊的，例如這扇窗。

divider screen: A screen in the main hall that guards against evil spirits. horseback gable: The rounded top of the side wall, shaped like a horse's back. stone chime: The lion bites a stone chime, qing. It sounds like the word for celebration. hexagonal: Having six sides, like this window.

八角形的：有八個邊的，例如這扇窗。 葫蘆：形的裝飾象徵福氣吉祥。 風獅爺：屋頂上守護房子的小獅子。 壁鎖：S 形的鐵件，把牆和木樑鎖在一起。

octagonal: Having eight sides, like this window. gourd: Gourd-shaped decorations bring good luck. wind lion: A little lion on the roof that guards the house. wall lock: An S-shaped iron piece that ties the wall to the beams.

淡水井：這裡挖得到淡水。沒有水，就沒有城。

fresh-water well: You can dig down to fresh water here. No water, no fort.

實景照片

Photos on site

海山館綠色劍獅 Green lion at the Haishan Hostel

海山館大門上方，一尊綠色劍獅從牆面凸出來，口咬一把劍。紅色門聯「居仁、由義」出自《孟子》，意思是心存仁愛、依義而行。

Above the door of the Haishan Hostel, a green sword lion sticks out from the wall with a sword in its mouth. The red door couplet means: live in benevolence, follow righteousness.

紅磚天井 The Red-Brick Courtyard

海山館的天井鋪著紅磚，四周是藍灰色的木造房子。當年從福建輪調來的班兵，就住在這裡。

Red bricks pave the courtyard of the Haishan Hostel, with blue-grey wooden rooms around it. Soldiers sent over from Fujian once lived here.

劍獅刀劍屏 The Sword Lion Screen

刀劍屏上畫著一隻劍獅：額頭有「王」字，嘴裡咬著一把劍，屏風頂上還排著刀劍兵器。據說它能擋住壞運氣，保護房子。

This divider screen shows a sword lion. It has the character for king on its forehead and a sword in its mouth, and weapons stand along the top. It is said the screen keeps bad luck away from the house.

木雕花窗 Carved Wooden Windows

紅、綠、藍色框裡的木雕格窗，中間各有一個圓形的「壽」字，祝福人長壽。

These carved wooden windows have red, green and blue frames. In the middle of each is a round character for long life.

花瓶彩繪 The Vase Painting

藍底白色的彩繪，中間是一個像花瓶的器物圖案。民間裝飾常用「瓶」代表「平安」，因為兩個字的讀音很像。

This blue panel is painted with a white vase design. In folk art, a vase often stands for peace and safety, because the two words sound alike in Chinese.

六角窗 The Hexagonal Window

藍色木牆上的六角窗，有六個邊。窗戶上方還有一塊彩繪的小木板。

This hexagonal window has six sides. Above it is a small painted board.

六角窗和八角窗 Six and Eight Sides

左邊是六角窗，右邊是八角窗。據說八角窗像八卦，可以避邪。

On the left is a hexagonal window, and on the right is an octagonal window. It is said the eight-sided window is like the eight trigrams, which keep evil away.

石條椅和石板地 Stone Bench and Paving

屋簷下有一條長長的石條椅，地上鋪著一塊塊的老石板。

A long stone bench sits under the eaves, and the ground is paved with old stone slabs.

山牆上的獅頭 The Lion on the Gable

山牆頂端有一個獅頭，下面掛著一幅書卷，叫做「書卷懸魚」。右邊的 S 形鐵件是壁鎖，圓窗是綠色的花磚窗。

At the top of the gable wall, a lion's head holds a scroll. The S-shaped iron piece is a wall lock, and the round window is made of green glazed tiles.

竹節書卷窗 The Scroll Window

白牆上的「竹節書卷窗」：窗框像一捲打開的書卷，窗櫺像一節一節的竹子。

This window on the white wall looks like an open scroll, and its bars look like bamboo. It is called a bamboo-joint scroll window.

「入孝」側門 The Side Gate

側門上貼著紅紙「入孝」，出自《論語》「入則孝」，意思是在家要孝順父母。門上方有彎彎的小屋頂。

The red paper on this side gate means, be good to your parents at home. The words come from the Analects of Confucius. A small curved roof sits on top of the gate.
